changes.title: Patterned light cost
items: The optional patterned-light preview prepares gentle flicker before drawing each pixel.
Patterned lighting remains optional while its performance is being checked.

changes.title: Render easing
items: Camera clearance and distant canopy now ease consistently at different screen refresh rates.

changes.title: Patterned light default
items: Soundsystems project moving light patterns by default, with textured spell rings and gentle lantern light. Reduced flashing switches them off.

changes.title: House ready at load
items: The treehouse's rooms and furniture are made while the loading screen is up, so they're all there when you wake, with no wait the first time you walk round the house

changes.title: Idle magic field
items: Smoother frames when no spell is leaving marks on the ground.
